Rule.value: AreaSearchAnchor points may select a search region only; they must never be passed directly to actor or vehicle creation.
No interior, entrance, exit, or interior ID is present unless it is sourced and independently verified.
Ground, collision, water, road, navigation, interior, obstruction, and entity-clearance checks belong to the GTA runtime.
EnhancedVerified remains false until tested in the target Enhanced runtime; a Legacy coordinate or file-version match is not proof.

Source.description: The 16 broad Crime Activity coordinate keys and authored Vector3 values migrated here from the former code dictionary, without asserting their real-world placement accuracy.
Names, district labels, and terrain labels for the 16 Crime Activity area candidates.
The 12 Dispatch search-anchor coordinates migrated from the pre-catalog form; the current event catalogue keeps their IDs and minimum/maximum player-distance selection rules as LocationRefs.
Local executable file version observed during project inspection only; no in-game native or location validation was performed.
Development-time RPF/map inspection and YMAP/YND tooling; not a runtime dependency and no asset coordinates were extracted in this pass.

Documents object-location dumps (for example ATMs, gas pumps, vending machines) and navigation-mesh data. Useful for research leads, but not proof of safe scene positions; repository data licensing/build provenance was not sufficient to redistribute here.
A browsable MLO/room/portal/YTYP catalogue; it does not by itself prove that a given location is accessible or spawnable in this SHVDN Enhanced runtime.

Fork of DurtyFree dumps listing 77,991 vehicle-navigation nodes, 7,137,375 navigation-mesh polygons, 360 MLO definitions at 808 locations, and many object placements. Its README pins the dump to update v2944 (Online 1.67), predating Enhanced; the repository listing showed no license, so no records or assets are redistributed here.

10,836 runtime-sampled records on a 100-unit grid with zone, street, interior, ground, water, and hash fields. This is a coarse sampled coordinate grid rather than a named-site or spawn database; the README does not pin the game build and no license was declared, so it is reference-only.

A community list of named bank/shop/garage door objects and positions, last active in 2021. Coordinate text uses locale-style comma decimals and the list has no declared reuse license or Enhanced build pin; it is not imported and cannot establish usable interior access.
Offline zone/road lookup example based on external node/zone data; not used as an LS Immersive dependency or coordinate authority.
Reference for GTA natives used to design runtime validation; not evidence that these coordinates passed those checks or that every signature was exercised through the local SHVDN Enhanced assembly.

Anyis LSCoordinate survey. Coordinates, capture IDs, raw geographic labels, observed ground-height values, non-zero interior IDs, candidate building anchors, actor references, and review relationships are selectively represented. The YAML payload and XML mirror are not embedded. Captures do not imply safe ped or vehicle spawning.
